description: This file defines a singleton actor, GatewayEndpointStore, responsible for managing and resolving the current gateway endpoint configuration within an app. It includes methods for subscribing to endpoint state changes, refreshing configuration, setting modes (local/remote), ensuring tunnels, and constructing URLs for dashboards and control endpoints. It also manages environment and config overrides, logging, and fallbacks. The file extensively references external configuration, connection modes, URL schemes, and network details relevant to gateway connections.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointStore
classes.description: A singleton actor that manages the gateway endpoint state, configuration, and related actions such as subscribing, mode switching, and ensuring remote tunnels.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of GatewayEndpointState updates, with buffering capacity.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reloads current configuration and updates the endpoint state accordingly.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the connection mode (local, remote, unconfigured) and updates the endpoint state.

methods.name: ensureRemoteControlTunnel
methods.description: Ensures that the remote control tunnel is established and returns its port.

methods.name: requireConfig
methods.description: Returns the current gateway connection configuration, waiting if necessary for remote setup.

methods.name: maybeFallbackToTailnet
methods.description: Attempts to fallback to a tailnet IP address if current URL matches certain criteria.
